fields.title: 📖 Allah sent down and made binding
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“A Sūrah which We sent down and made binding, and in which We sent down clear signs, so that you may reflect.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Revelation is not mere inspiration without binding force. It contains Farāʾiḍ, limits, and clear Aḥkām.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nūr 24:1.
